name: Standby – Coming Soon & Maintenance
author: Jaydip

sections.description:
Standby – Coming Soon & Maintenance is a modern, lightweight, and highly customizable plugin that allows you to put your website into Coming Soon or Maintenance Mode with professional templates and advanced features.

Key Highlights

  • Switch instantly between Coming Soon and Maintenance Mode
  • 100% responsive, super-fast, and SEO-friendly
  • Built using core WordPress standards
  • Works with any theme or page builder
  • No coding required

Professional Templates

  • Clean and minimal template design
  • Optimized typography and spacing
  • Templates: Classic, Modern, Minimal

Background Customization

  • Solid color
  • Custom image
  • Custom Video

Countdown Timer

  • Enable/disable countdown
  • Set end date / time
  • Auto-disable when countdown ends

Email / Newsletter

  • Built-in email subscription form
  • Honeypot spam protection
  • Admin notification
  • API support for:
    • Mailchimp
    • Brevo

Access Control

  • IP Whitelist
  • Allow logged-in users to bypass

Advanced Options

  • Social icons (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Dribbble)
  • Contact email / help / address

Admin Interface

  • Fully polished design
  • Tabbed settings panel
  • Support / help link in the header

How to Use

  1. Go to Standby → Settings
  2. Choose:
    • Coming Soon Mode
    • Maintenance Mode
  3. Select your template
  4. Customize:
    • Upload Logo
    • Title & Description
    • Background
    • Countdown
    • Social icons
    • Contact info
    • Email subscription
  5. Save and activate

1. Does this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes! It works with all themes including Astra, Divi, GeneratePress, Block Themes, etc.

2. Does it affect SEO?

Both modes send a 503 (Service Unavailable) response with a Retry-After header, which tells search engines the downtime is temporary. You can change the status code with the scsmm_status_code filter.

3. Can I allow only certain people to access the site?

Yes. You can allow:
– Logged-in administrators
– Selected IP addresses, IPv4, IPv6 and CIDR ranges (e.g. 203.0.113.0/24)

4. Does it block the REST API?

Optional. Enable Block REST API in the Access tab to stop published content being read via /wp-json/ for visitors while the mode is active.

5. Does the plugin collect or store any data?

The plugin itself does not track users or collect analytics.

If the Local email provider option is enabled, subscriber email addresses entered in the Coming Soon / Maintenance form are stored in the site’s WordPress database. This data is stored only on your website and is never sent to any third party.

You can view, export (CSV) and delete subscribers under Standby → Subscribers. All plugin data is removed when the plugin is deleted.

6. Will this slow down my website?

Not at all — the plugin is extremely lightweight and optimized.

7. Does the plugin support video backgrounds?

Yes. MP4 and WebM video backgrounds work in all three templates. The background image is used as the poster/fallback, and the video is not shown for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

You can upload or select an MP4 video from the WordPress Media Library and use it as a background. For best performance, it is recommended to use optimized, short-length videos and avoid very large file sizes.

8. Can I whitelist IP addresses?

Yes. You can add specific IP addresses to a whitelist.

Visitors coming from whitelisted IPs will be able to access the website even when Coming Soon or Maintenance Mode is active.

Credits

This plugin uses the following open-source libraries, images, html templates:

Fonts (bundled locally, no external requests)

Roboto, Poppins, Space Mono, Tinos, DM Sans and Inter, served from the plugin folder.

    https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/LICENSE

Bootstrap Icons v1.13.1

  • https://icons.getbootstrap.com/
  • Copyright 2019–2024 The Bootstrap Authors
  • Licensed under the MIT License:
    https://github.com/twbs/icons/blob/main/LICENSE

FREE HTML5 TEMPLATE

  • http://freehtml5.co/

Start Bootstrap

  • https://startbootstrap.com

Demo Images

https://pixabay.com/service/license-summary/

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party email marketing services to allow users to subscribe visitors to mailing lists.

Mailchimp

Used to add subscribers to a Mailchimp mailing list.
Data sent: Email address entered by the user.
When: Only when the subscription form is submitted.
Service provided by Mailchimp:
https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/
https://mailchimp.com/legal/privacy/

Brevo (Sendinblue)

Used to add subscribers to a Brevo contact list.
Data sent: Email address entered by the user.
When: Only when the subscription form is submitted.
Service provided by Brevo:
https://www.brevo.com/legal/termsofuse/
https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/

1.3

New
* Subscribers screen (Standby → Subscribers): view, export to CSV and delete locally stored subscribers.
* Video backgrounds (MP4 / WebM) now work in all three templates, including Modern.
* Background image is used as the video poster and fallback; video is skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
* Logo now displays in the Minimal template.
* Mailchimp double opt-in option.
* IP whitelist supports IPv6 and CIDR ranges (e.g. 203.0.113.0/24) and validates entries.
* “Add my IP” button now adds your real IP address.
* Optional “Trust proxy headers” setting for sites behind Cloudflare or a load balancer.
* Optional “Block REST API” setting to hide public content from /wp-json/ while the mode is active (off by default).
* Countdown shows a message when it reaches zero.
* “Settings” link on the Plugins screen.
* Redesigned admin settings page: new header with status badge, icon tabs, section cards, toggle switches, sticky Save bar and mobile-friendly layout.

Fixed
* Subscribe form did not work in the Minimal template.
* Background color only worked in the Modern template; it now works in Classic and Minimal, and themes can no longer override it.
* Color backgrounds were covered by a dark overlay; the overlay now only appears on image and video backgrounds.
* Text automatically switches to dark on light background colors (Classic).
* Honeypot spam protection was not active.
* Countdown and auto-disable now use the site timezone and agree with each other.
* The auto-disable request no longer shows the page one extra time.
* Subscriptions are rejected when the subscribe form is turned off.
* Duplicate emails no longer cause errors with Mailchimp or Brevo.
* Brevo no longer sends an invalid list ID when none is set.
* Logo file names used the wrong case, breaking the image on Linux servers.
* Removed a broken background image reference in the Minimal stylesheet.
* Admin bar notice is styled on every screen and shows the correct mode.
* Modern template: countdown wraps on small screens, and image/video backgrounds now show on phones.
* Settings-saved notice no longer appears inside the page header.

Security
* All settings are validated and whitelisted on save; unknown values are discarded.
* API keys are masked, never printed back into the page, and can be removed with a checkbox.
* Subscribe messages are displayed as plain text.
* Rate limiting uses a fixed window and the correct visitor IP.
* Subscribers are stored without autoload and capped at 5,000 (filterable).
* Uninstall now also removes rate-limit transients and supports multisite.

Changed
* Fonts are bundled with the plugin; no requests to Google Fonts.
* Admin Bootstrap is scoped to the plugin page and no longer restyles wp-admin.
* Script and style handles are prefixed with “scsmm-“.
* Both modes send a 503 response with a Retry-After header (filter: scsmm_status_code).
* Core block and global styles are removed from the standalone page.
* Unused image files were removed.
* The “Bypass for logged-in users” label now reads “Administrator bypass” to match what it does.
* The old countdown “Style” dropdown was removed because it had no effect.
* Existing settings and subscribers are upgraded automatically on first load.

1.2

  • New Added Minimal Template Layout.
  • Added video background support for Classic style.

1.1

  • New Added Modern Template Layout.
  • New Added Social Media – LinkedIn, Pintrest, Dribble
  • Fixed issue toggle menu not working in device

1.0

  • Initial release
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/standby-coming-soon-maintenance
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Standby → Dashboard
  4. Enable Coming Soon or Maintenance Mode
  5. Customize the template and you’re done
